    "Coin B, gold-colored disc: 00:00.000–00:00.750 visible inside the front-left cup; 00:01.000–00:02.000 the right hand reaches into that cup and obscures it; 00:02.250–00:02.750 a matching disc is visibly lifted out in the right-hand pinch.",
    "Coin B: 00:03.000–00:04.250 held above and lowered toward the front-left cup's rim; 00:04.500–00:06.750 visibly retained outside the cup in the right hand, descending toward the cloth. A release into the cup is not established.",
    "Coin B: 00:07.000–00:08.250 partly hidden by right fingertips and overlapping cup rims; 00:08.500–00:09.750 visibly raised in the same hand above the cups, still a gold-colored disc.",
    "Coin C, large gold-colored disc in the initially central cup: 00:00.000–00:04.000 remains visibly tilted inside that cup; the lowering, moving viewpoint subsequently obscures the interior. No hand removal or contradictory destination is visible.",
